reason: RMR is an external real estate manager and investment adviser. It sponsors and manages REITs, operating companies and private capital vehicles, and its customers are those managed entities. Orion is a self-managed single-tenant office REIT that owns buildings and earns rent from corporate and government tenants. The two share a commercial real estate end market. The business model and buyer differ, so Orion is not a useful comp for valuing RMR.
